subject: Recovered-client courtyard diagnostic after creature health fallback deployment
setup: Isolated namespace with copied auth/game binaries, world and character databases; production was untouched. Game DLL was extracted from deployed rasa_net_game:creature-health-respawn-20260923. The copied world has the six staged courtyard Thrax 198660-198665, three staged camp companions 198688-198690 and one Forean Warrior 198691; it loads 410 content rows with three unrelated incomplete mission-definition gaps, versus 404 rows and zero gaps live. Alden starts at the previously client-reached (316.13,120.28,85.93), level 2, with mission 1994 objective 2 active. Recovered original client is compatibility build 1.16.5.0.
observations: Client logged in and Game created private instance 2 of context 1985 at 20:00:05.221 local; MapLoaded arrived at 20:00:18.334. The harness detected a playable HUD after 36.497 seconds and saved playable.png. The game loaded 110 sandbag cover triangles.

Ordinary W movement for four seconds advanced Alden to (308.7,120.1,79.2). The approach screenshot shows a targetable level-2 Thrax Infantry Initiate ahead and a visually filled recruit health bar. The cave area 198602 probe was 32.5 m from center versus its 10 m diagnostic radius.

A three-second rifle auto-fire command at a manually placed reticle spent two rounds (3/1000 to 1/1000 in screenshots). A red -48 appears near the fight, but the trace does not identify who caused that number or quantify target HP. No Thrax kill or cave objective completion was observed.

Long inspection pauses left Alden standing at (308.7,120.1,79.2). Game logged his death at 20:02:50.238, 151.904 seconds after MapLoaded, caused by Thrax entity 2750 (placement 198665). The recovered client displayed the Refugee Base Medic hospital selection. This duration includes pauses and is not a comparable encounter-survival measurement.

The earlier prequeued creature-health-combat-02 run reached the same copied checkpoint, but its initial fire resolved against entity 0 because the reticle had no live target. The first attempt ended when its non-PTY harness was terminated during a blocking wait; it gives no combat result.
limits: This confirms startup, private-instance creation, movement, firing, cover asset loading and death/hospital presentation on the deployed-derived binary in a staged copied world. It does not independently measure the creature's internal HP, validate the 555 analogue, complete the natural courtyard encounter, establish final-live aggro or balance, or compare directly with uninterrupted final-week footage. The staged Warrior/companion placements are absent from the live world database. The deployed-derived game image also lacks some worktree companion follow/assist changes (ContentMaterializer, BehaviorManager and MissionContentRuntime differ), so this replay cannot verify the complete staged ally implementation.
next_action: Run an uninterrupted client-controlled courtyard encounter with target and hit tracing, using the original footage's visible route as the comparison. Keep the seeded max_hp and attacker behavior labelled until their final-live values are evidenced.
